_about: Short-film categories (Wan, 22 Nov 2026: "Untuk short film ada kan dua kategori - kisah keluarga halal dan cats, dan kategori ini boleh ditambah"). The built-in ones are here; Wan's own are the settings row `short_films` ({categories: [...], hidden: [...]}), merged over these by id (same id replaces, a new id is added). Read by backend/semasa/short_films.py and web/src/lib/shortFilms.js. A category with a `script` is filmed from it word for word; one without is written by the writer from its cast, setting and style plus the day's topic. A FILE for Wan to watch: nothing here posts or approves.

about.bm: Hana dan Hassan di kedai runcit: satu soalan halal sehari-hari, dijawab dengan rujukan.
about.en: Hana and Hassan at a sundry shop: one everyday halal question, answered with its reference.

cast.name: Hana
cast.look: a young Malaysian woman wearing a pastel pink hijab (tudung) and a cream blouse, natural friendly smile

cast.name: Hassan
cast.look: a Malaysian man in his thirties, short black hair, black-rimmed glasses, navy blue polo shirt, calm confident expression

categories.setting: a Malaysian sundry shop (kedai runcit), in front of a shelf of packaged snacks

voice.notes: Dialog ditulis dalam prompt babak dan disebut oleh video itu sendiri. Bahasa Malaysia harian, pendek.

script.sheet_prompt: Photorealistic character sheet, two real people standing side by side, full body, facing the camera, soft even lighting, inside a Malaysian sundry shop (kedai runcit), in front of an open glass-door refrigerator or freezer cabinet stocked with chilled food: on the left, Hana, a young Malaysian woman wearing a pastel pink hijab (tudung) and a cream blouse, natural friendly smile, holding a small packaged item near the refrigerator, a small orange cat perched in her other arm near her chest, the orange cat looking at the refrigerator; on the right, Hassan, a Malaysian man in his thirties, short black hair, black-rimmed glasses, navy blue polo shirt, calm confident expression, pointing at the refrigerator shelf. Behind them, a few blurred shoppers walk past casually. The orange cat and the open refrigerator are clearly visible. Highly detailed faces, natural skin texture, realistic proportions. No text, no logo, no watermark, no cartoon, no illustration.

scenes.prompt: Photorealistic video, vertical 9:16 portrait framing. Di kedai runcit di Malaysia, Hana, perempuan bertudung merah jambu dan berbaju krim, memandang bungkusan snek kuning di tangan dengan wajah hairan. Hassan, lelaki bercermin mata hitam dan berbaju polo biru laut, berdiri di sebelah. Hana berkata eh logo halal ni ada tarikh luput ke, ingatkan kekal je. Tiada dialog lain. Kamera statik.

Photorealistic video, vertical 9:16 portrait framing. Di kedai runcit di Malaysia, rak makanan snek yang sama, latar yang sama persis seperti video sebelum ini, Hassan, lelaki bercermin mata hitam dan berbaju polo biru laut, terus bercakap sambil memberi isyarat tangan. Hana, perempuan bertudung merah jambu, berdiri di tempat yang sama mendengar sambil membelek bungkusan snek kuning. Hassan berkata sijil halal ni ada tempoh, makanan macam ni biasanya dua tahun, ubat dengan kosmetik pulak sampai tiga tahun. Hana tersenyum lega dan berkata baru tahu sekarang, dulu tak tahu ada tarikh luput halal ni. Tiada dialog lain. Kamera statik.

panel_lines.text: Eh, logo halal kat paket ni warna hijau. Bukan sepatutnya hitam ke?
Pemegang sijil boleh cetak logo ikut warna pembungkusan, asalkan spesifikasi logo tak diubah.

about.bm: Tiga ekor kucing di kampung Malaysia: cerita pendek tentang persahabatan, dengan narator.
about.en: Three cats in a Malaysian kampung: a short story about friendship, with a narrator.

cast.name: Comot
cast.look: a ginger orange tabby with a white chest and green eyes

cast.name: Putih
cast.look: a fluffy pure-white long-haired cat with blue eyes

cast.name: Belang
cast.look: a young black-and-white tuxedo kitten with yellow eyes

categories.setting: a Malaysian kampung: the wooden steps of a kampung house, the edge of a green padi field, a wooden pangkin

voice.name: Sulafat
voice.notes: Seorang narator, Bahasa Malaysia, satu ayat pendek setiap babak. Kucing tidak bercakap.

script.sheet_prompt: Photorealistic wildlife-style photograph, three real cats sitting side by side on the wooden steps of a Malaysian kampung house, facing the camera, soft warm morning light, shallow depth of field, full body of each cat visible: on the left Comot, a ginger orange tabby with a white chest and green eyes; in the middle Putih, a fluffy pure-white long-haired cat with blue eyes; on the right Belang, a young black-and-white tuxedo kitten with yellow eyes. Highly detailed fur, natural proportions, three clearly different cats. No people, no text, no logo, no watermark, no cartoon, no illustration.

scenes.prompt: Photorealistic video. Pagi di kampung Malaysia. Comot, kucing oren, menguap dan meregangkan badan di tangga kayu sebuah rumah kampung. Putih, kucing putih gebu, dan Belang, anak kucing hitam putih, berjalan menghampirinya dengan ekor tegak. Cahaya matahari pagi yang lembut. Kamera statik, pergerakan semula jadi.
scenes.narration: Pagi di kampung. Comot, si kucing oren, baru bangun, dan dua sahabatnya sudah menunggu.

scenes.prompt: Photorealistic video. Comot, Putih dan Belang berjalan beriringan di batas sawah padi yang hijau pada waktu pagi, ekor tegak, sekali-sekala saling memandang. Kamera mengekori perlahan dari sisi.
scenes.narration: Bersama Putih dan Belang, dia meronda di tepi sawah, seperti setiap pagi.

scenes.prompt: Photorealistic video. Di bawah sebatang pokok, Comot menjumpai seekor ikan di atas daun pisang. Dia menolak ikan itu ke tengah, dan Putih serta Belang mendekat. Ketiga-tiga kucing makan bersama dengan tenang. Kamera statik.
scenes.narration: Hari ini Comot menjumpai seekor ikan. Walaupun lapar, dia berkongsi dengan kawan-kawannya.

scenes.prompt: Photorealistic video. Petang di kampung, cahaya matahari terbenam yang keemasan. Comot, Putih dan Belang tidur bersusun rapat di atas pangkin kayu, perut kenyang, mata terpejam. Kamera bergerak perlahan menghampiri mereka.
scenes.narration: Kerana bagi Comot, kawan yang baik lebih berharga daripada seekor ikan.
